root_idea.summary: The root encompasses distinct lexical branches centered on a foundation or base, a highly dangerous serpent, and the evening period.
root_idea.development: The foundation branch extends from a thing's root or lowest support to establishment, permanence, origin, lineage, essential principles, and removal from the root. The time branch designates the period after the afternoon, while the serpent branch remains lexically distinct.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Grouped with the matching QAC أَصِيل form under the normalized singular citation form for the evening period.
Displayed under the normalized noun أَصْل.
Grouped with the matching nominal QAC form under the normalized singular citation form أَصِيلٌ; the Quranic occurrence is an adverbial time expression.

senses.definition: The evening period, from the afternoon prayer or late afternoon until sunset.
senses.usage_conditions: Used both as a noun, including the plural آصال, and adverbially in expressions meaning “in the evening.”

senses.definition: The root, base, or lowest supporting part of a thing.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, it refers to the root or foundational lower part of a tree, including the root of the parable's tree, its bottom, and the roots of trees being cut.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take root, or become firmly founded, established, and strong.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a thing, especially a tree or plant, that develops a firm root or foundation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become firm or sound; of a person, to be sound and intelligent in judgment; and of judgment or opinion, to become firm, sound, or good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The personal and judgment-related applications are Classical uses of the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become eminent, noble, or honorable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form I use describing the acquisition of distinction or honor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or hit the root, foundation, or ultimate constituent of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive use directed at the part on which a thing depends or by which it is what it is.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To know something completely or thoroughly, as though reaching its root or ultimate constituent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic transitive construction occurring with عِلْمًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become altered for the worse in taste and odor, or spoiled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said especially of water affected by fetid black mud, and also of meat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set about or commence doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person beginning an action or undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give something a firm or fixed root or foundation on which another thing can be built.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form II use; it can also describe making property established or firmly based.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To arrange, classify, distribute, or set in order the fundamentals or principles of a field.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical Form II construction used of organizing the principles of a science or discipline.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter upon the period called أَصِيل.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV time expression referring to the beginning of the evening period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To uproot, cut off, or remove something completely from its root; hence to eradicate, extirpate, or destroy utterly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used literally of plants, horns, ulcers, or the prepuce, and figuratively of people or groups that are completely destroyed or extirpated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An origin, source, basis, parent, stock, or lineage from which something proceeds or on which it depends.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes relations such as a father to offspring or a river to a branch stream, as well as origin or stock in matters of descent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Immovable or established property, especially land, a house, or palm trees; also a source of wealth, capital, or principal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A property term for assets regarded as a lasting foundation rather than as merchandise for immediate trade.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The entirety or whole of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions meaning to take or receive something with its root, the sense is completely or without leaving anything.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ever, at any time, or at all.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Adverbial use in negation or prohibition, distinct from the concrete noun meaning root or base.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The original or elemental matter, material, substance, or constituent from which something is taken or made.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical use equivalent to the source material or essential substance of a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fundamentals, foundational articles, principles, elements, or rudiments of a science or doctrine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the technical expression عِلْمُ الأُصُولِ for the study of fundamental doctrines or principles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A radical or essential letter of a word, as opposed to an augmentative letter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical grammatical terminology concerning the essential elements of a word.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The original form of a word.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical lexicographical and grammatical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The original or primary signification of a word.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical use distinguishing a basic meaning from a derived or figurative one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An original copy or exemplar of a book, especially a copy from which one quotes or transcribes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a manuscript or textual source serving as the basis for copying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The original, former, or natural state or condition of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes returning to an earlier or natural disposition and legal or customary statements about the default state of things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The utmost point or degree to which a person or thing can be brought, or the utmost effort one can make.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in idiomatic expressions involving driving or constraining someone to their limit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The essence, reality, or ultimate constituent by which a thing is what it is.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract Classical use closely associated with the thing's essential constitution, not merely its physical root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The principal, purest, best, or choicest part of something; its core or prime portion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May refer to the principal dwelling place of a people or the foremost part of a group or lineage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A basic or governing principle: what is proper or standard, the default state, the predominant or literal interpretation, what is essential, or a general rule.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical abstract use in statements of legal, logical, grammatical, or interpretive principle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An indication, evidence, or proof for what is indicated, evidenced, or established.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical use for a basis that demonstrates or proves a conclusion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extirpating, eradicating, or excising thoroughly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or descriptive use applied to removal from the root or to complete excision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A highly venomous serpent, described as short or broad and capable of springing upon and killing its victim.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Descriptions vary as to its size and shape; the associated expression أَصَلَتْهُ الأَصَلَةُ describes the serpent springing upon and killing someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Short and broad.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival application to a man or woman, derived from the description of the serpent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Radical, fundamental, primitive, original, or underived.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of an essential letter or a primary signification, in contrast with an augmentative or figurative one.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Radicalness, originality, or the quality of being fundamental or rooted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical noun used for the quality expressed by أَصْلِيٌّ and also in place of تَأَصُّلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Firmly rooted, established, stable, permanent, or enduring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: By extension, it describes firm or sound judgment, deeply founded glory, and, in a particular expression, deeply rooted or vehement evil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of established lineage or pedigree; noble, generous, or well-born.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical personal epithet referring to a person's rootedness in lineage or distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Destruction or death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical nominal use recorded as a designation for ruin or death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man's whole established property, especially his palm trees, or land long possessed or inherited from his parents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional property term for inherited or longstanding land and assets providing one's livelihood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The whole of something or everyone together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions meaning to take something altogether or for a group to come in its entirety.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person skilled in the science of fundamentals or principles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical occupational noun derived from أُصُولٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Entering upon the evening period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived participial or descriptive use for arriving as the time called أَصِيل begins.

cautions: The two QAC groups headed أَصِيل are presented together under the singular citation form أَصِيلٌ: the Quran uses both nominal plural آصال and an adverbial form أَصيلًا for the evening period.
The Classical rooted, established, noble, and serpent-related uses of أَصِيلٌ/أَصَلَةٌ are kept separate from the Quranic evening sense.
